content:
Apple has adjusted trade-in values for several iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch models, as well as some Android phones. Here are the latest prices.

Apple updated its trade-in value list today, with most products seeing an increase in their recycling price, and some devices rising by nearly 30%. The company also added several Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, and OnePlus models to the list.
